title: should add a print viewBox to a metric panel SVG when print mode is enabled
verifies: a metric panel's SVG has no viewBox before print and gains a `0 0 w h` viewBox after the print toolbar toggle

title: should apply a print viewBox when the dashboard loads directly with ?print=true
verifies: loading the dashboard view with `?print=true` applies the SVG viewBox on mount without clicking the button

title: should keep a non-metric panel on canvas and never add an SVG viewBox in print mode
verifies: a line (canvas) panel stays a `<canvas>` and gains no `<svg>`/viewBox when print mode is entered

title: should give each of multiple metric panels its own print viewBox
verifies: each of two metric panels receives its own `0 0 w h` viewBox in print mode
